characters.name: Grandma Cinders

leaderSkill.name: Everyone Eats
leaderSkill.desc: With all five elements on the team: all allies ATK x2.2 and REC x1.5.

activeSkill.name: Fresh Batch
activeSkill.desc: Convert the bottom row to Fire orbs. Straight from the oven.

passive.name: Fireproof Apron
passive.desc: Takes 15% less damage from Fire enemies. Decades of oven incidents.

awakened.abilityDesc: Fresh Batch also heals the party. Nobody knows what's in it. Nobody asks twice.

characters.flavor: The kingdom's most wanted arsonist for thirty years. Retired the day she discovered sourdough. The fire never left — it just learned to proof.

characters.name: Sir Toasty

activeSkill.name: Pop-Up Shield
activeSkill.desc: Shield the party, reducing damage taken this turn. DING!

passive.name: Two Slots
passive.desc: Can absorb two hits per battle with reduced damage.

characters.flavor: Knighted after shielding the royal breakfast from a dragon. The dragon got the bagel. Nobody else was harmed.

characters.name: Pepper the Recruit

leaderSkill.name: Fresh Legs
leaderSkill.desc: All allies gain +1 second of movement time.

activeSkill.name: Double Time
activeSkill.desc: Extend movement time by 3 seconds this turn. She read the drill manual TWICE.

passive.name: Eager to Please
passive.desc: +20% skill charge for adjacent party members. It's infectious.

characters.flavor: Joined the Meadow Watch to protect her village. So far she has protected two picnics and a duck. Undefeated.

characters.name: Smokey Joe

leaderSkill.name: Low Coals, High Stakes
leaderSkill.desc: Fire allies ATK x2 while party HP is below 50%.

activeSkill.name: Flare-Up
activeSkill.desc: Deal heavy Fire damage to one enemy. The grill demands it.

passive.name: Well Done
passive.desc: +15% ATK while below half HP. He works best under pressure and smoke.

characters.flavor: Died at his grill. Refused to leave his grill. The grill and Joe are a package deal now, and the brisket is ETERNAL.

characters.name: Her Dampness

leaderSkill.name: All Streams Converge
leaderSkill.desc: With 3+ elements on the team: all allies HP, ATK and REC x1.6.

activeSkill.name: Royal Reflection
activeSkill.desc: Convert the four corners to Water orbs and set up the next cascade.

passive.name: Everywhere At Once
passive.desc: Cannot be bound. She is technically every puddle.

awakened.abilityDesc: Royal Reflection converts the corners AND the center column. The throne room floods politely.

characters.flavor: The Suspicious Puddle was never following the party. It was ESCORTING them. Royalty travels incognito, and occasionally as drizzle.

characters.name: Coach Cascade

leaderSkill.name: Flow State
leaderSkill.desc: All allies +1 second movement time. At 5+ combo, Water allies ATK x2.

activeSkill.name: Extended Set
activeSkill.desc: Extend movement time by 4 seconds this turn. FEEL the flow. BE the flow.

passive.name: Downhill Momentum
passive.desc: Cascade matches grant +50% extra skill charge.

characters.flavor: A waterfall that got really into coaching. Clients report 'unbelievable flow' and 'constant, thorough dampness'.

characters.name: Brinebeard

leaderSkill.name: Plunder Ledger
leaderSkill.desc: Mercenary allies ATK x1.8. Gold drops +10%.

activeSkill.name: Audit the Booty
activeSkill.desc: Deal Water damage to one enemy. Every doubloon accounted for.

passive.name: Offshore Accounts
passive.desc: Keeps 10% of HP safe from any single hit.

characters.flavor: Sails under the dread flag of the Balanced Books. His crew fears no navy, only the end of the fiscal year.

characters.name: Mildred
characters.epithet: Meadow Watch Lifeguard (The Creek Is Ankle Deep)

activeSkill.name: Rescue Whistle
activeSkill.desc: Heal the party and cleanse poisoned orbs. TWEET. Everyone out of the board.

passive.name: Certified
passive.desc: Heart matches heal 15% more. She has the badge and the sunscreen.

characters.flavor: Guards a creek you could step over. Has performed 41 rescues, all of them beetles. Takes each one deadly seriously.
